Pinecliff Racing's Global Goal will look at another Group 1 target after winning the G1 Flight Stakes. Snitzel had a 3-year-old stakes double with exciting colt The Next Episode who heads to the G1 Coolmore Stud Stakes, while Wonka will stay in Sydney for the G1 Spring Champion Stakes.

The opening three stakes races of the juvenile season went to the expected stables in Sydney with Gai Waterhouse celebrating her tenth G3 Breeders' Plate with Flying Houdini who has Blue Diamond ambitions. Michael Freedman's Gimcrack winner Shraddha drew comparisons to Manaal, while in Melbourne Musandam will be set for the G1 Blue Diamond.

The spring is heating up nicely, and Saturday brings plenty of action to both Sydney and Melbourne. While the juveniles make their first raceday appearances at both bases, several G2 Premiere Stakes acceptors vie for a spot in the G1 The Everest, while a valuable Ciaron Maher-trained entire seeks a G1 Caulfield Cup spot and a handful of 3-year-olds tune up for the G1 Coolmore Stud Stakes in the G2 Danehill Stakes.

Randwick hosts two of the first juvenile stakes races of the season on Saturday with the G3 Gimcrack Stakes for fillies attracting a good sized field of 13. First season sire Anamoe is represented by Runaway Diva who comes from last year’s winning trainers Gai Waterhouse and Adrian Bott.

Eight juvenile colts are set to line up in the G3 Breeders' Plate at Randwick on Saturday. Last year, first season sire Stay Inside had the perfect beginning to his stud career with victor Incognito and Ole Kirk achieved the same with King Kirk the year before. This year, three first season sires have runners, Anamoe, Hitotsu and State Of Rest.

Yesterday, we examined how overseas training systems prepare 2-year-olds for racing. In Part 2, we look at how trials, race programming and financial incentives help explain why a greater proportion reach the track overseas than in Australasia.

There is no doubting the quality of one stallion's book this year in the Hunter Valley, and that would be The Autumn Sun, who enjoys a fee raise to $137,500 (inc GST) in recognition of his achievements to date. Arrowfield Stud's Bloodstock Manager Jon Freyer gives us a glimpse of the mares they are entrusting him with this spring.

Juvenile stakes action kicks off at Flemington on Saturday, with the Listed Maribyrnong Trial Stakes where a field of six juveniles are set for the early scamper down the straight for precocious black type. Trial winner Ankaa represents first season sire Anamoe.
